title: Warm intention allows an honest correction

captions.physics: Removing help built on mistaken assumptions
captions.emotions: Feeling clarity in a fair decision

meaning: Your warmth can preserve honesty when you stop mistaken help and consider the actual consequences of a kind intention for you both.
text: A good intention becomes more attentive when it allows an honest correction. In the physical position of Anahata, the Tower shows help being stopped because its foundation has proved mistaken. The Sun in energy brings a wish to share open warmth and make your presence simple and friendly. Justice in emotions offers clarity when a decision’s consequences are acknowledged and considered for both. Delighting each other may matter while hearing that delight did not arrive feels unpleasant. Tenderness does not require protecting a good atmosphere at the cost of silencing a concrete inconvenience or an important objection.

Suppose one gives something belonging to the other to a mutual acquaintance, planning a pleasant surprise from you both. It emerges that the item was not meant to be given away. **A warm plan does not replace agreement to a gift.** The handover can stop and the one-sided decision be acknowledged. Clarity appears in a concrete correction rather than a required smile to preserve a kind impression of the encounter.

Difficulty appears if honesty becomes a tally of who has delighted the other more often. Alternatively, goodwill hurries the matter closed by calling it trivial. Care stays proportionate to the action. Warmth towards someone can remain and choice return without requiring immediate forgiveness or the surrender of a fair objection for a cheerful shared mood.
